findings.reason: binding §2 to SETTLED_STATES/HIDDEN_AT_ATTACH and to ACTIONABLE_RECOVERY_CLASSIFICATIONS replaces two partitions that would drift from the ones the fleet counter already folds.
findings.text: §2's terminal set ("recorded, promoted, withdrawn, discarded") and its coordinator-kind catch-all ("a recovery verb other than observe or empty counts as coordinator") duplicate existing owners: (1) "a state a run does not leave / asks for nothing" is already owned by SETTLED_STATES ticker.py:329 and HIDDEN_AT_ATTACH ticker.py:349, and the settled words by FLEET_SETTLED_STATES recovery.py:10569 — none of them contains `withdrawn` or `discarded`, so the same file would carry a fourth partition of the same states; (2) "which recovery classifications need the coordinator" is owned by ACTIONABLE_RECOVERY_CLASSIFICATIONS recovery.py:181, which excludes `wait` and `promote`, so §2's verb test disagrees with that owner for kinds outside COORDINATOR_KINDS.

findings.reason: the section must account for the interface surface it adds — name what the adjacent deprecated filter leaves behind, or state why nothing can be retired or merged.
findings.text: §3 adds a new `--all` option to `crew follow` (reconcile against the existing set at cli.py:5100 and the deprecated `--attention` filter at cli.py:5133) without naming what it retires or merges; §2 adds a settle-window module constant (§2 text: "a module constant beside ARRIVAL_WINDOW") against public_definitions 1586.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §2 changes one class (RowPolicy) behind its existing feed/flush/seed interface plus one mode on PaneRowPath; §3 releases held rows through the existing wait pass; no new wrapper chain is added.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §2 defines a terminal-state partition inline and re-derives "needs the coordinator" beside owners that already hold both.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 1586, cli_options 336, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; §3 adds a crew follow CLI option without naming what it retires or merges, or why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §1–§3 name and extend the existing machinery (RowPolicy, PaneRowPath via follower_row_path cli.py:3723, replay_row_policy ticker.py:1412, transition_class ticker.py:1146, COORDINATOR_KINDS ticker.py:1070, ARRIVAL_WINDOW ticker.py:1130, _follow_gap_rows cli.py:3924, RowPolicy.flush) and key the new policy on the persisted recovery field (recovery.py:11003) rather than a new classification.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §3 adds a flag to the existing crew follow command rather than a parallel command.
